observations: Photos show a car alternator (belt-driven charging unit) with cooling fins and mounting ears.
Photo 0 shows one side with the pulley/rotor area and vented housing.
Photo 1 shows the opposite side with a circular end plate and mounting points.
Photo 2 shows the rear side with a threaded shaft/pulley end and electrical connection area.
No visible brand/model number, part number, or label is readable in the photos.

claims.evidence: No Belgium/origin paperwork or label is visible/readable in the photos.
No test video, bench test reading, or proof of operation is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show internal condition, mileage, or whether it was opened.

claims.claim: Also deals on all kinds of cars spare parts.
claims.evidence: This is general business text; photos only show one alternator.

risks.risk: Wrong alternator fitment (different engine/vehicle/part number). Photos don’t show a readable part number or vehicle compatibility.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the alternator label/part number (and/or the exact vehicle/engine it fits) plus the connector type.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: may be the wrong part for the buyer’s car (effectively not usable).

risks.risk: Not actually working (diode/regulator/brush wear may fail under load even if it looks intact).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of it being tested (bench test or installed test) showing voltage output/charging behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: not working.

risks.risk: Pulley/bearing noise or internal damage not visible externally.
risks.proof: Ask for a video of the pulley spinning by hand and/or a running test showing no abnormal noise.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: may have bearing/pulley issues.

risks.risk: Missing accessories/incorrect mounting hardware (some alternators require specific brackets or have different mounting ear configurations).
risks.proof: Ask what is included (only alternator or also brackets/bolts) and request photos of all included parts laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case: only the alternator body is included.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the alternator label/engraved part number (and any barcode/serial).
Confirm exact vehicle/engine compatibility (make/model/year + engine code) matching the buyer’s car.
Provide a short test proof: bench test results or installed charging test (voltage/current) video.
Show what’s included in the package (alternator only vs any brackets/bolts/wiring).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is an alternator, but the key pricing drivers (exact part number/fitment and verified working condition) are not readable or proven in the images or seller text.
